summary: Configured and verified the three-node MariaDB Galera cluster. All nodes are Primary, Synced, Ready, and enabled for persistent automatic rejoin/restart. Database/Galera ports are restricted to cluster members; MariaDB security hardening and root-only generated credentials are in place. No disruptive reboot or failure test was performed, per instruction.
actions_performed: Installed MariaDB, Galera, SST, and nftables packages on node1, node2, and node3.
Configured cluster membership, node identities, replication, gcache, SST, network-online ordering, and restart-on-failure.
Applied persistent firewall rules restricting ports 3306, 4444, 4567, and 4568 to the three member IPs.
Removed anonymous users, remote root accounts, and the test database; configured root socket authentication and disabled local_infile.
Verified cross-node committed writes, shared cluster UUID, Primary status, cluster size 3, Synced state, and Ready state on every node.
Generated and validated unique node-local DBA credentials through secret_env without exposing secret values.
